title: Absorb an Autonomous Warlord
subject_brief: Two battered 1940s command helmets crushed together inside one heavy blood-smeared iron clamp, one blank insignia plate snapping as the jaws close.

title: Appoint a Regional Governor
subject_brief: A heavy 1940s brass administrative stamp pressing a bloody handprint into a cracked wooden district block, with one large iron key tucked behind it.

title: Purge a Resistant Rival
subject_brief: A broken 1940s officer baton pinned beneath a broad butcher cleaver, the severed wood and blade streaked with fresh dark blood.

title: Issue a Continental Command
subject_brief: A battered 1940s field telephone handset lashed to a command whistle by blood-wet wire, forming one forceful diagonal order emblem.

title: Prove the Continental Chain of Command
subject_brief: Three massive iron chain links pulled taut across a dented field stopwatch, the middle link bloodied but unbroken.

title: Centralize the Larder
subject_brief: A padlocked wartime cold-storage crate bound by converging rail straps, its lid rim and drain stained with thick dark blood.

title: Convert a Captured Workshop
subject_brief: A rusted industrial gear biting into a large meat hook above a blood-slick wartime anvil, unmistakably workshop machinery turned into butchery.

title: Abandon an Exhausted Frontier
subject_brief: A collapsed barbed-wire gate and broken wartime boundary post beside an overturned empty ration tin, with a receding bloody drag trail.

title: Designate a Feeding Capital
subject_brief: A reinforced central meat-vault door with four thick rail lines converging into its bloody threshold, a single severe industrial capital symbol.

title: Burn Through the Near State
subject_brief: An open wartime furnace mouth devouring two blood-streaked ration sacks, orange flame and gore bursting from one bold black silhouette.

title: Rotate a Managed Feeding District
subject_brief: A circular steel butcher carousel with three anonymous wrapped meat bundles turning around one greasy blood-coated crank.

title: Move the Prisoner Trains
subject_brief: A huge 1940s prison railcar wheel fused to a barred wagon door, wrapped in bloody transport chain and caked with track mud.

title: Process the Battlefield Yield
subject_brief: A torn wartime field stretcher tipping anonymous bloody remains into a compact recovery hopper, with one dented helmet beside it.

title: Keep the Continental Ledger Moving
subject_brief: A blood-smeared blank ledger book strapped to a toothed conveyor wheel, its pages whipping while the mechanism keeps turning.

title: Establish an Air Program Foundation
subject_brief: A battered 1940s aircraft propeller freshly bolted to a bloodied industrial anvil, with one rivet hammer and no complete aircraft.

title: Create a Cannibal Legion
subject_brief: An empty 1940s steel infantry helmet rising above a blood-filled mess tin, backed by one worn rifle bayonet and torn webbing.

title: Surge a Cannibal Legion
subject_brief: Three battered 1940s infantry helmets bursting upward from a blood-soaked deployment crate under a snapped chain.

title: Recruit Island Reavers
subject_brief: A rusted naval grappling hook driven through a torn wartime life ring, tangled with bloody rope and a chipped boarding knife.

title: Recruit Siege Eaters
subject_brief: A massive sledgehammer crushing a concrete bunker ration hatch, broken masonry and dark blood spraying from the impact.

title: Recruit a March Predation Column
subject_brief: A mud-caked 1940s truck tire wrapped in butcher chain, driven forward over a blood-stamped marching boot sole.

title: Raise a Bone Guard
subject_brief: A 1940s steel helmet reinforced with anonymous jawbones, crossed with one chipped bayonet and one blood-darkened long bone.

title: Launch a Continental Hunt
subject_brief: Wartime field binoculars trapped in a wide butcher snare, crossed by a bloodied bayonet that points aggressively forward.

title: Collapse an Enemy Front
subject_brief: A sandbag barricade collapsing under one brutal tank-tread segment, snapping barbed wire and crushing an abandoned bloodied helmet.

title: Launch a Continental Naval Hunt
subject_brief: A dark wartime ship propeller entangled with two heavy meat hooks, wet rope and blood swirling around the blades.

title: Process a Convoy-Hunt Receipt
subject_brief: A wartime cargo crate split open by a ship hook, revealing anonymous bloodied butcher bundles among thick naval rope.

title: Build a Silent Anchorage
subject_brief: A blackened naval anchor chained across a barred prisoner-hulk porthole, dripping blood into still dark water with no ship visible.

title: Launch an Air Interdiction Hunt
subject_brief: A 1940s aircraft propeller slashing through a chained supply rail, with torn canvas cargo and blood spatter caught in the blades.

title: Feed the War Machine
subject_brief: A huge toothed industrial flywheel biting into a blood-soaked steel helmet and spent wartime shell casings.

title: Seed a Major Enemy Army
subject_brief: An opened 1940s ration tin concealing a bloodied mechanical parasite of gears and wire, ready to be slipped into an army pack.

title: Prepare a Global Campaign
subject_brief: A scarred globe clamped inside a 1940s campaign belt while a bloodied bayonet and rail spike pin it from opposite angles.

title: Issue a Terror Ultimatum
subject_brief: A sealed black wartime dispatch envelope impaled by a broad bloodied bayonet, the blank wax seal cracked with no symbol or writing.

title: Provoke a Cell-Backed Border Incident
subject_brief: A barbed-wire border fence exploding apart around a concealed wartime rifle muzzle, bloody wire whipping across the silhouette.

title: Integrate a Postwar State

title: Destroy a Coalition Hub
subject_brief: A smashed 1940s field-radio exchange box with severed cables, crushed beneath a blood-smeared engineer hammer.

title: Convert Counterwar Pressure
subject_brief: A heavy wartime pressure valve and armored coil bending an incoming artillery shell back into a bloodied gear train.

title: Consume the Counterwar
subject_brief: Two opposing wartime bayonets snapping a thick coalition chain across a dented field stopwatch, blood pooling beneath the broken links.

title: Begin Terminal Mobilization
subject_brief: A giant wartime factory alarm siren with its lever forced down by a blood-soaked gauntlet, three steel helmets surging beneath it.

title: Empty a Conquered Province
subject_brief: A hollow ruined apartment block being crushed into an industrial harvest hopper, its empty windows and chute overflowing with dark blood.
